channel.title: Violations Watch: grave violations against children
channel.description: New incidents tagged with one of the six grave violations against children (UN Security Council resolution 1612). Open-source leads, not UN-verified cases.

item.title: Russian attacks on Odesa Oblast late on 24 Nov kill two people, including a teenager, and injure one (State Emergency Service via Kyiv Independent); a drone strike on a residential courtyard in Kyiv injures two
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Odesa Oblast, Ukraine. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Russian forces. Reported casualties: 2 killed, 3-4 injured. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: The State Emergency Service figures (Kyiv Independent) list two killed, one a teenager born in 2009, and one injured in Odesa Oblast; an injured 12-year-old girl in earlier entry not found in that report; AP headline says children wounded, details not confirmed. 5 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2016

item.title: Houthi-run health ministry says Saudi-led coalition attacks on Sanaa, Hodeidah, Hajjah, Taiz and Saada killed 41 civilians and injured 35, including women and children, over 48 hours (22–24 Nov)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Yemen. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Saudi-led coalition. Reported casualties: 41 killed, 35 injured. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Figures from Houthi officials, not independently verified. Democracy Now reports the Houthi claim as 41 civilians killed in a single day, including in Hodeidah and Lahij, with no injured figure and no mention of women or children; the 48-hour period, 35 injured, other governorates and women and children come from Saba and Press TV only. 9 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2032
